design_context.previous_observation: proper scores improved slightly but pooled Top1 was flat, season Top1 directions disagreed, and max absolute 1X2 probability shift was about 0.1879
design_context.use_of_previous_observation: mechanism design motivation only; this new candidate remains post-view development, not fresh confirmation

identity_preflight.primary_rule: gate only the 713 fixtures where season + canonical home + canonical away + kickoff UTC minute agree exactly across both frozen metadata sources
identity_preflight.secondary_rule: report but do not gate a 760-fixture sensitivity cohort joined by unique season + canonical home + canonical away; use FPLCache kickoff only for FPLCache snapshot cutoff identity

feature_contract.player_importance: snapshot minutes divided by sum(snapshot minutes) over all players currently assigned to that team; if denominator <= 0, all player importances are 0
feature_contract.window_signed_availability_delta: d_w = away_impairment_w - home_impairment_w for each frozen cutoff window
feature_contract.bounded_effective_tilt: t = temporal_consensus_delta / (1 + abs(temporal_consensus_delta)); because each impairment is in [0,1], d is in [-1,1] and |t| is intrinsically <= 0.5
feature_contract.missing_fallback: fail the affected cohort; no label-driven imputation

single_frozen_candidate.baseline: Frozen V3.1.1 1X2 probabilities and 15x15 joint matrix from artifact 9876751277
single_frozen_candidate.one_x_two_transform: compute d24,d6,d90 from frozen status+minutes snapshots; m=median(d24,d6,d90); t=m/(1+abs(m)); unnormalized q_H=p_H*exp(t), q_D=p_D, q_A=p_A*exp(-t); normalize q to sum 1
single_frozen_candidate.joint_transform: KL/I-project the frozen V3.1.1 matrix by multiplying all home-win cells by q_H/p_H, draw cells by q_D/p_D, away-win cells by q_A/p_A; preserve within-outcome score shape exactly
single_frozen_candidate.mechanism_origin: pre-scoring robustification: median across three PIT snapshots suppresses one-window transients; self-normalization preserves first-order direction near zero and bounds leverage without a searched coefficient

interpretation_rule: PASS requires positive pooled Top1 net-correct count, nondegrading Top1 in both season blocks, and nondegrading proper scores. PASS remains post-view development evidence only and cannot authorize promotion. FAIL rejects only this exact frozen temporal-median bounded mechanism.
